title: Bias Analysis and Mitigation through Protected Attribute Detection and Regard Classification
findings: The paper proposes a scalable pipeline to analyze and mitigate social biases for various protected attributes, including religious groups. It uses protected attribute detection and regard classification to identify stereotypes, such as associating Muslim people with terrorism and extremism, within the Common Crawl pre-training corpus. The findings demonstrate that their method can identify such biases and that balancing the regard distributions (e.g., downsampling negative texts) is a promising approach for mitigation.
